title: Example explainer
name: example-overview
about: It shows the shape of a piece: an opening, a before and after in one frame, and a close on the first thing to do.

brief.purpose: the purpose file this piece follows, e.g. purpose-teach-a-tool.md
brief.fix: The outcome of stage 2 (explainer; explainer and a job aid), its reason, and anything routed to the subject's owner and where.
brief.viewer: Who watches, what they already have or know, what they are in the middle of when they need this, and every stated assumption.
brief.scope: Where the viewer starts and where the piece stops; what is left out on purpose and where each thing left out is covered.
brief.where_it_plays: The form (page, video file, both), sound, and the place viewers will find it.
brief.must: Anything it must say or must not show; UNCONFIRMED where it is still a guess.
brief.source: What the piece was made from, and its version (a commit, a version line, a date on the page).
brief.problem: Purpose line: replace with the purpose file's own lines (problem, action, ...).
brief.action: Purpose line: a verb the viewer performs after watching.

scenes.idea: Names the subject and says what the viewer will be able to do after watching.

lines.say: This opening line names the subject, and says what the viewer will be able to do in their own work after watching.
lines.caption: This opening line names the subject, and says what the viewer will be able to do in their own work after watching.
lines.stage: Title card: the subject's name, a rule, An overview.

scenes.idea: The problem and the fix, shown in one frame so they are compared in place.

lines.say: Show the problem first, in the frame the fix will use.
lines.caption: Show the problem first, in the frame the fix will use.
lines.stage: One box, labelled Before, with a drawn cross.

lines.say: Then show the fix in that same frame, so the eye compares in place instead of from memory.
lines.caption: Then show the fix in that same frame, so the eye compares in place instead of from memory.
lines.stage: The same box, now After, with a drawn tick; Before fades out.

scenes.idea: The first act: what the viewer does next, by its real name.

lines.say: End on the first thing the viewer does next, by its real name.
lines.caption: End on the first thing the viewer does next, by its real name.
lines.stage: Start here, above one highlighted chip.
